description: This file defines the SubTotal class in the OpenCart project, which extends the system's Model class and provides functionality to calculate and add the subtotal to the list of totals during order processing.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Represents the subtotal total extension in OpenCart, responsible for calculating and adding the subtotal to the order totals.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of items in the cart, including vouchers, and appends this total to the totals array.
